project_info.color_palette: Intense orange, white, gold, stadium green

main_subject.detail: A bright orange SPay campaign poster with giant headline 'HOA NHIP BONG LAN' and subheadline 'NHAN QUA CUC KHUNG'. The letter O is stylized as a shattered soccer ball. Center foreground features a large white-and-orange soccer ball on a football field, a gold trophy on the left, and a light-gold Samsung phone with stylus on the right. Orange ticket labels say '10 TRIEU DONG' and '30 TRIEU DONG'.
main_subject.style: High-energy stadium promotion visual with glossy 3D objects and oversized sports typography
